description: Ask Ted the Tax Guy, an AI tax guide, one US federal or state tax question in plain words. Ted searches only indexed official IRS (and some state tax agency) pages and answers in a few short paragraphs with numbered citations [n] that map to the returned source links. It declines topics outside US tax and says so when no official page answers. Slower than the calculators (often 10 to 40 seconds) and rate limited: for a figure from the user's own numbers, prefer the calculator tools. General information, not tax advice.

question.description: One US tax question in plain words, with any numbers that matter, e.g. 'Can I deduct my home office if I rent?'

tax_year.description: The tax year the figures are for (2025, 2026, 2027). Leave it out for the default: last year's return until April 15, then the current year.

name: ask_ted
title: Ask Ted a tax question
